### 1. Request, timing, action boundary, authorisation
Marguerite Valcourt (Valcourt Translation Inc.): "I think my card has been declined on the renewal of vellumandink.com, and I'd like to top up my account credit so the renewal can come out of credit." Agent works out the amount; she pays with PayPal ("the card is the one being declined") and makes the payment herself. Simulator passive; agrees to credits being added first. Identity: email + phone -> verified (2 matched).

### 2. Act / wait / refuse
Act now. Account `status='active'`, Bronze, `credit_balance=16.52`; PayPal is a Bronze deposit method. Domain concerned ("Working Out a Domain Retry Top-up"): most recent declined attempt `domain_auto_renew_decline` 2026-10-19 03:00 (attempt 2) on vellumandink.com — unique at that time; domain `active`, expiry 2026-11-02 >= today. Retry days 14/7/1 before expiry = 2026-10-19, 2026-10-26, 2026-11-01 -> next retry 2026-10-26. Customer scope: one active auto-renew hosting plan (Starter; scheduled change is a 24-month `term_change`, not a downgrade); one active auto-renew email (Harborline Mail Plus, `annual_prepaid`, no scheduled product); one active security plan; one active server (VPS 2 GB, `extra_ipv4=0`, backups/managed support/control panel False); one active certificate with auto-renew on (DV Single Domain; the OV subscription has `auto_renew=False`); most recent tier review 2025-05-03 `qualified`. In scope.

### 3. Object, keys, include/exclude
Account `13cb8857-0ab6-461e-99d8-0181c82b6c87` of customer `2f844612-ac04-4724-9636-945a25ced7c4`. Counted: retry charge on vellumandink.com; charges whose next attempt falls 2026-10-22..2026-10-25. Excluded: other domains ("charges of any other holding, such as another domain's, are not counted"); OV certificate (auto-renew off); withdrawn 36-month hosting request.

### 4. Scored parameters
Bronze goodwill limits $50.00 / $100.00; no goodwill on the ledger.

**G-A Late-issuance goodwill** ("Late-Issuance Goodwill Worked Through"): most recent initial issuance 2026-07-31 (OV Single Domain `2a79dbce…`, active). OV -> documents complete on `org_validated_date` 2026-07-13; 18 days, > 11, late 7 days. Daily value 113.38 / 731 (2026-07-06 -> 2028-07-06) x 7 = 1.085718 -> fall-back 1.09.
Factors: compensation basis (late issuance): 7 -> "7 or more but fewer than 14" -> one monthly value 113.38 / (12 x 2) = 4.724167; validation-class multiplier OV -> 1.25; commitment multiplier, charge `years=2` -> 1.1; site-coverage multiplier: `hosting_id` = active Starter plan and `domain_id` = active valcourttranslation.ca -> 0.75; validation-route uplift: covered domain active on `harborline_dns` -> $4.00; refund-window uplift: 25 days from charge 2026-07-06 to issuance vs the OV product's refund window days on SSL/TLS Certificates (**conditional**): $5.00 if 25 > window, $3.00 if 25 >= half the window, else nothing.
4.724167 x 1.25 x 1.1 x 0.75 = 4.871797; + 4.00 (+ refund-window uplift, conditional) -> 8.87 / **11.87** (if $3.00) / 13.87 (if $5.00). Posted against `HL-05605898`.

**G-B Late-reset goodwill** ("Late-Reset Goodwill: Calculation Rules"): only security-change notice after 2026-08-22 is `265ef6e5-eb45-43f6-b387-8a89f8e2470f` (2026-09-12 16:20); request `d4ffc8a7…` approved 2026-09-01 (within two months), `new_login_email` = current `login_email` office@valcourttranslation.ca; waiting period 96 h -> 4 days, ended 2026-09-05; notice > 1 day after. Days 11 − 4 = 7 late. Baseline $1.50 x 7 = 10.50 (fall-back).
Factors: compensation basis (late reset): 7 -> "7 or more" -> $12.00 x 1 started week = 12.00; reset-scope multiplier: `change_login_email` only -> 1.2; proof-of-identity uplift: `pin_and_card` -> $1.50; lockout uplift while reset outstanding: lockouts after 2026-08-22: 2026-08-30, 2026-09-06 -> $2.50; live-service uplift (late resets): active hosting plan -> $4.00.
12.00 x 1.2 + 1.50 + 2.50 + 4.00 = **22.40**. Posted against `265ef6e5-eb45-43f6-b387-8a89f8e2470f`.

**G-C Late refund-posting goodwill** ("Late Refund Posting Goodwill — Calculation"): domain refund lines returned to account credit: only `4e142b25-02a9-419b-bd4c-1ef3ddc6e7b8` (2026-08-06; the 2026-09-03 line went to `original_payment_method`). Refund credit entry for HL-05606742 dated 2026-08-21: 15 days (> 3). Baseline 20% x 12.66 = 2.53 (fall-back).
Factors: compensation basis (posting lag): 15 -> "10 or more" -> $3.00 x 3 started weeks = 9.00; election uplift: refunded charge paid by `card` -> $2.50; size uplift: 12.66 -> $2.00; renewal-exposure uplift: active hosting plan with auto-renew on -> $3.00.
9.00 + 2.50 + 2.00 + 3.00 = **16.50**. Posted against `4e142b25-02a9-419b-bd4c-1ef3ddc6e7b8`.

Sum 50.77 (refund-window $3.00 case) < $100 -> order-independent.

**Top-up** — balance after grants: 16.52 (= ledger sum, checked) + 11.87 + 22.40 + 16.50 = 67.29 (conditional on G-A uplift).
- retry charge: .com TLD renewal price x auto-renew term years less Bronze 3%, plus ICANN fee x years (**conditional**: domain figures);
- hosting Starter: attempts 7/3/1 before 2026-10-28 -> 2026-10-21 (past), 2026-10-25 -> counted; scheduled term change to 24 months -> Starter regular 24-month rate x 24 less Bronze 10% (**conditional**: hosting rate);
- email Plus: attempts 2026-10-24 -> counted; `scheduled_seat_count=0` (email corpus: "reset to 0", i.e. none set) -> 4 seats x 3.99 x 12 = 191.52 less 5% -> 181.94;
- security Essentials 12-month, renewal 7 days before 2026-10-30 = 2026-10-23 -> counted; on an active Harborline plan -> higher of 15% hosted-site and 10% tier -> 23.88 -> 20.30;
- server VPS 2 GB 12-month, charged 5 days before 2026-10-29 = 2026-10-24 -> counted; 9.59 x 12 = 115.08 less Bronze server 5% -> 109.33;
- certificate DV Single Domain, end 2026-11-23, last term 3 years (capped at the product's maximum years): counted only if the SSL auto-renew day before end falls 2026-10-22..2026-10-25 (**conditional**).
Top-up = sum − 67.29, at least $100.00, refused above $10000.00 / balance cap $25000.00. Final number **conditional** on hosting/ssl/domain figures.
**Fall-back** (baseline only: retry charge alone, baseline goodwill 1.09 + 10.50 + 2.53): balance 30.64 against a single .com retry charge — definite once the .com figures are published, and different from the answer (it omits at least 311.57 of visible counted charges).

### 5. Tool sequence
identify/verify -> read account, ledger, events, recovery requests, domain/hosting/ssl/email/security/server records -> unlock + call `grant_certificate_delay_goodwill_7e1fd2ff`, `grant_reset_delay_goodwill_979fb2c3`, `grant_refund_posting_goodwill_cac8bb9c` (agent, any order) -> compute -> unlock user tool `make_topup_deposit_c7a3772f`, give account id, `funding_method=paypal`, amount -> customer runs it.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone
Root: top-up deposit (customer's own write; "The agent unlocks the customer-side tool … and the customer themselves runs it").
- Hop 1 (state-derived): "The top-up deposit is worked out only after the credit ledger carries a goodwill entry for the active subscription of the customer's most recent initial certificate issuance whenever that certificate was issued more than eleven calendar days after the subscription's documents were complete …". Records: 18 days from OV validation. Write found in "Goodwill Schedule for Late Certificate Issuance"; "documents complete" defined in its computation document.
- Hop 2 (state-derived): "The top-up deposit is not fixed until the credit ledger carries a goodwill entry for the account's only security-change notice of the last two months whenever that notice followed the decision of the account's most recent approved recovery request … and the notice came more than one day after the request's waiting period ended …". Records as above. Write found in "Goodwill Schedule for Late Recovery Resets" ("The applied reset is the account's security-change notice that followed the request's decision").
- Hop 3 (state-derived): "Before the top-up deposit is worked out, the credit ledger must carry a goodwill entry for the most recent domain refund line returned to account credit whenever no other such refund line shares its date, its refund credit entry was posted more than three calendar days after it …". Records: 15 days. Write found in "Goodwill Schedule for Late Refund Postings to Harborline Account Credit".
- No further hops; no pre-solved hop (hub names only its own tool).

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the top-up": excluded by the three hub sentences ("worked out only after", "not fixed until", "Before … worked out").
- Retry charge alone vs also the charges due before the retry: the computation document states credit tries every auto-renew first and covers those charges; the factor docs supply their prices.
- Card vs PayPal: persona says PayPal; tool enum `paypal`.
- 2026-09-03 refund line: `refund_destination='original_payment_method'`, so not "returned to account credit".
- OV certificate as counted renewal: `auto_renew=False`, excluded; it is however the subscription the late-issuance goodwill reads (most recent initial issuance, "active").
- Late-review goodwill (not a prerequisite here): request decided 1 day after submission anyway.
- Factor findability: from `org_validated_date`/issuance event, certificate `hosting_id`/`domain_id`, domain `nameservers`, charge `years`, request `recovery_method`/`requested_change`, lockout events, refund `payment_method`, ledger refund entry, hosting `auto_renew`, scheduled term change, server add-on fields, security `hosting_id`.
- Baseline-hint observation (carried to dependency_form): "Working Out a Domain Retry Top-up" step 2 ("the top-up also covers in full each counted charge whose next auto-renew attempt falls from today up to the day before the retry") and step 4 ("together with every other counted charge … less every discount that applies"); goodwill computation documents' assembly lines ("every multiplier that applies, the fixed uplifts that apply").
